content.title: Game Preview: Warriors vs. Houston Rockets - 4/5/26
content.text: WARRIORS HOST DURANT FOR EASTER SUNDAY MATCHUP, HOPEFUL FOR CURRY RETURNThe Warriors host Kevin Durant and the Houston Rockets at Chase Center on Easter Sunday. Durant won two finals MVPs with the Warriors in 2017 and 2018. The Dubs are highly anticipating the return of 12-time All-Star Stephen Curry and forward Gui Santos echoed those sentiments following Thursday’s game. “You cannot measure it brother,” Santos said of the team’s excitment level for Curry’s return. “We’re very happy to have him back. For me, he’s the greatest of all time.” Curry has participated in multiple scrimmages over the past few days and was a full participant in the most recent practice. The team awaits an official update on his status ahead of Sunday’s game. Durant and Curry have yet to play against each other this season. Sunday's game as a later start time than usual on weekends, tipping off at 7 p.m. LAST TIME OUTThe Warriors fell 118-111 to the Cleveland Cavaliers in a back-and-forth game at Chase Center on Thursday night. Brandin Podziemski and Gui Santos both scored 25 points for the Dubs, including a 14-point fourth quarter for Podziemski. Donovan Mitchell led the Cavaliers with 25 points, while both Jarrett Allen (16 PTS, 13 REB) and Evan Mobley (12 PTS, 10 REB) recorded double-doubles. »Full StoryVideo Player is loading.Current Time 0:00Duration -:-Remaining Time -:-Highlights: Golden State Warriors vs. Cleveland Cavaliers | 4/2/26PLAY-IN TOURNAMENT PREVIEWThe Warriors are in the final month of the 2025-26 NBA regular season, with the Play-In Tournament taking place from April 14-17 and the Playoffs tipping off on April 18. The Dubs have clinched a spot in the Play-In Tournament featuring the seventh through 10th seeds. Golden State is currently in 10th place and two of the other Western Conference play-in teams are solidified — the Los Angeles Clippers and the Portland Trail Blazers. »Full StoryCOMPELLING NOTE: Warriors: Gui Santos recorded his first career double-double on Jan. 26. From that game on, Santos has taken his game to another level, averaging 15.8 points and 5.7 rebounds on a 63.0 true shooting percentage over a 29-game span. Santos ranks second on the team in total points (458) and total rebounds (164) during that stretch, only trailing Brandin Podziemski in both categories. The Warriors reached a multi-year contract extension with Santos and he's established himself as an important piece of the team's future. Rockets: Kevin Durant passed Michael Jordan on the NBA’s all-time scoring list this season and has been remarkably durable in this 18th campaign, having missed just three games overall and only one to injury. Durant is the only player this season averaging at least 25 points per game while shooting over 50 percent from the field and over 40 percent from three. There have only been 10 such seasons by a player since 2020 and Durant accounts for half of them, meaning he’s accomplished this feat in five of the last six seasons. Play-In: The top six teams in each conference, ranked in order by win-loss records, qualify for the playoffs.
